data.description:
# Re-base Herdr in-progress UI behaviour on status

## Goal

As a Herdr user, I want an item being actively worked (its `status` is
`in-progress`) to keep the stage tag and the metadata Last-command panel even
though its `stage` is `plan_complete`/`intake_complete`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The list-row stage-tag suppression currently keyed off `item.stage === 'in_progress'` is re-based on `status === 'in-progress'` (`worklist.ts` ~1355).
- [ ] The metadata-panel Last-command reservation (`reserveLastCommand`) is re-based on `status === 'in-progress'` (`worklist.ts` ~2020-2026).
- [ ] The Last-command lookup for the metadata panel is re-based on `status === 'in-progress'` (`worklist.ts` ~6252).
- [ ] Actively-worked items (`status = 'in-progress'`, stage `plan_complete`/`intake_complete`) keep the same UI behaviour previously provided by the removed `in_progress` stage.
- [ ] Tests cover the status-based in-progress UI behaviour (list-row stage tag and Last-command panel reservation/lookup).

## Minimal Implementation

- Replace the three `stage === 'in_progress'` checks with `status === 'in-progress'` checks.
- Add/adjust tests in `tests/herdr/worklist.test.ts` using `status: 'in-progress'` fixtures.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts`
- `tests/herdr/worklist.test.ts`

## Dependencies

- Blocked by the STAGES alignment task (Stage type no longer includes `in_progress`).

## Deliverables

- Status-based in-progress UI behaviour with tests.

data.comment:
## Implementation notes

- Re-based the three `stage === 'in_progress'` checks in `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` on `status === 'in-progress'`:
  - list-row stage-tag suppression (`formatItemLine`),
  - metadata-panel Last-command reservation (`reserveLastCommand`) and line rendering (`formatMetadataPanel`),
  - live-TUI Last-command lookup (`runWorklistTui`).
- Extracted the lookup into an exported pure helper `resolveMetaLastCommand(item)` so the status-based lookup is unit-testable (mirrors the panel reservation; fail-soft on a missing log).
- Tests: list-row stage-tag status behaviour (`tests/herdr/worklist.test.ts`) and Last-command reservation/lookup (`packages/herdr/src/worklist.test.ts`, incl. new `resolveMetaLastCommand` suite). Migrated the shared `makeRichItem` fixture status from invalid `in_progress` to valid `in-progress` and updated the status-rendering assertions it touches.
- Verified: `npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/herdr/tsconfig.json` clean; targeted suites 523/523 green; declared full suite (`.pi/test-config.json`) green after `npm run build`.

### Pre-existing failures discovered (NOT caused by this item)
Full `npx vitest run` reports 9 failures in 3 files — a gap left by WL-0MUY1CRS7001UTQJ (C3): `tests/herdr/fetcher-memo.test.ts`, `packages/herdr/src/fetcher-timeout.test.ts`, `packages/herdr/src/setWorklogDir.test.ts` all call `fetchItemsByStage('in_progress'|'open'|'stage-N')` and expect a `wl` CLI invocation, which the C3 invalid-stage guard now (intentionally) suppresses. These are fixture-migration work assigned to C1 (WL-0MUY1CQM6005HV9M) by the plan and are outside this item's UI-rebase scope; the declared full suite used by the gate is green.
